name: self_check_expected_error
sql: SELECT error('miint browser check')

name: setup_playground_seqs
sql: CREATE TABLE seqs AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('foo', 'AAATATAGATGAGTGTGCTGTGTAGTGATCGTAGTGATCGATGTGATGTGTGAACCACACACCACCACACCGAGCTAGTCTG')) AS t(read_id, sequence1)

name: playground_rype_extract_minimizer_set
sql: SELECT read_id || ' ' || fwd_set::VARCHAR || ' ' || rc_set::VARCHAR FROM rype_extract_minimizer_set('seqs', 64, 10)

name: setup_sequences
sql: CREATE TABLE sequences AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('seq1', 'ACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGTACGT'), ('seq2', 'TGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCATGCA'), ('seq3', 'GGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGGCCCCGGGG'), ('seq4', 'ACGTTGCAAGGCTTACCGATGCATCGATCGGATCCTAGCTAGGCTAACGTTAGC')) AS t(read_id, sequence1)

name: rype_extract_minimizer_set
sql: SELECT count(*) || ' rows, md5=' || md5(string_agg(read_id || ':' || fwd_set::VARCHAR || '|' || rc_set::VARCHAR, ';' ORDER BY read_id)) FROM rype_extract_minimizer_set('sequences', 32, 10)

name: rype_extract_strand_minimizers
sql: SELECT count(*) || ' rows, md5=' || md5(string_agg(read_id || ':' || fwd_hashes::VARCHAR || '|' || fwd_positions::VARCHAR || '|' || rc_hashes::VARCHAR || '|' || rc_positions::VARCHAR, ';' ORDER BY read_id)) FROM rype_extract_strand_minimizers('sequences', 16, 8)

name: setup_counts
sql: CREATE TABLE counts AS SELECT sample_id, feature_id, value FROM (SELECT 'S' || lpad(s::VARCHAR, 2, '0') AS sample_id, 'F' || f::VARCHAR AS feature_id, (((s * 7 + f * 3) % 11) + CASE WHEN s <= 6 AND f <= 2 THEN 4 WHEN s > 6 AND f >= 5 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE AS value FROM range(1, 13) t1(s), range(1, 7) t2(f)) WHERE value > 0

name: setup_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE meta AS SELECT 'S' || lpad(s::VARCHAR, 2, '0') AS sample_id, CASE WHEN s <= 6 THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS label FROM range(1, 13) t(s)

name: setup_rmeta
sql: CREATE TABLE rmeta AS SELECT 'S' || lpad(s::VARCHAR, 2, '0') AS sample_id, (s * 1.5 + (s % 3) * 0.25)::DOUBLE AS y FROM range(1, 13) t(s)

name: input
sql: SELECT count(*) || ' cells, sum=' || sum(value) || ', md5=' || md5(string_agg(sample_id || '|' || feature_id || '|' || value::VARCHAR, ',' ORDER BY sample_id, feature_id)) FROM counts

name: fit_classifier
sql: CREATE TABLE m AS SELECT * FROM fit_classifier('counts', 'meta', n_estimators := 25, random_state := 7, name := 'm')

name: clf_model
sql: SELECT 'md5=' || md5(model_blob) || ' bytes=' || octet_length(model_blob) || ' n_samples=' || n_samples || ' n_features=' || n_features || ' n_estimators=' || n_estimators || ' task=' || task || ' random_state=' || random_state || ' feature_id_type=' || feature_id_type FROM m
expect: md5=0d0191d3fcb38c7639a95ecfb0fa500b bytes=6915 n_samples=12 n_features=6 n_estimators=25 task=classification random_state=7 feature_id_type=VARCHAR

name: clf_predict
sql: SELECT list(prediction ORDER BY sample_id)::VARCHAR FROM predict('counts', 'm')
expect: [A, A, A, A, A, A, B, B, B, B, B, B]

name: clf_known_feature_fraction
sql: SELECT list(round(known_feature_fraction, 6) ORDER BY sample_id)::VARCHAR FROM predict('counts', 'm')

name: clf_proba_exact_md5
sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(sample_id || ':' || class || '=' || probability::VARCHAR, ',' ORDER BY sample_id, class)) FROM predict_proba('counts', 'm')

name: clf_shap_exact_md5
sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(sample_id || '|' || class || '|' || feature_id || '|' || shap_value::VARCHAR || '|' || base_value::VARCHAR, ',' ORDER BY sample_id, class, feature_id)) FROM shap('counts', 'm')

name: clf_importances_exact_md5
sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(feature_id || '=' || importance::VARCHAR, ',' ORDER BY feature_id)) FROM feature_importances('m')

name: fit_regressor
sql: CREATE TABLE r AS SELECT * FROM fit_regressor('counts', 'rmeta', n_estimators := 25, random_state := 7, name := 'r')

name: reg_model
sql: SELECT 'md5=' || md5(model_blob) || ' bytes=' || octet_length(model_blob) || ' n_estimators=' || n_estimators || ' task=' || task FROM r

name: reg_predict_exact_md5
sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(sample_id || '=' || prediction::VARCHAR, ',' ORDER BY sample_id)) FROM predict('counts', 'r')

name: reg_shap_exact_md5
sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(sample_id || '|' || feature_id || '|' || shap_value::VARCHAR || '|' || base_value::VARCHAR, ',' ORDER BY sample_id, feature_id)) FROM shap('counts', 'r')

name: cv_classifier
sql: SELECT DISTINCT metric || ' mean_score=' || mean_score::VARCHAR || ' std_score=' || std_score::VARCHAR || ' fold_scores=' || fold_scores::VARCHAR FROM cross_validate_classifier('counts', 'meta', n_folds := 3, n_estimators := 10, random_state := 7)

name: cv_classifier_oof
sql: SELECT list(sample_id || ':' || prediction || '/' || actual ORDER BY sample_id)::VARCHAR FROM cross_validate_classifier('counts', 'meta', n_folds := 3, n_estimators := 10, random_state := 7)

name: cv_regressor
sql: SELECT DISTINCT metric || ' mean_score=' || mean_score::VARCHAR || ' std_score=' || std_score::VARCHAR FROM cross_validate_regressor('counts', 'rmeta', n_folds := 3, n_estimators := 10, random_state := 7)

name: fit_threads_1
sql: CREATE TABLE m1 AS SELECT * FROM fit_classifier('counts', 'meta', n_estimators := 25, random_state := 7, name := 'm1', threads := 1)

name: fit_threads_1_md5
sql: SELECT md5(model_blob) FROM m1
